name: structlog OTel health checks
short_definition: Production observability for Python ASGI services: JSON structured logs via structlog + contextvars (request_id/trace_id), OpenTelemetry traces/metrics (OTLP) with FastAPI/httpx/SQLAlchemy instrumentations, Sentry for error tracking, and /health/live + /health/ready probes — same 60-second request-ID correlation story as the TS stack in observability.md.
scope_in: Request-scoped bind: request_id, user_id, route, latency_ms
FastAPI / ASGI middleware for access logs and span attributes
Correlation with Next.js/Rust services via W3C traceparent
scope_out: Prometheus federation / long-term metric storage ops

defaults.logs: structlog 26.x JSON to stdout; merge_contextvars; ISO timestamps UTC; filter health noise
defaults.correlation: Generate or propagate X-Request-ID; bind via contextvars in middleware; include in error JSON body
defaults.traces: OTel SDK + FastAPI + httpx + SQLAlchemy/asyncpg instrumentations; OTLP exporter; service.name resource
defaults.errors: sentry-sdk FastAPIIntegration; set_user id only (no email in high-security); source maps N/A for Python — release + dist tags
defaults.health: GET /health/live (process up) and /health/ready (deps: DB SELECT 1, optional Redis); exclude from access-log spam
defaults.env: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, SENTRY_DSN, LOG_LEVEL via pydantic-settings

use_when: Multi-service traces need to join Next → Python → Postgres
On-call needs request_id chase across logs
do_not_use_when: Local one-off scripts (plain logging.INFO is fine)
Full OTel stack before first deploy — start with structlog + health, add OTLP when collector exists

alternatives.stdlib_json: python-json-logger alone — acceptable minimal; prefer structlog for bind/contextvars
alternatives.loguru: Popular but not stack default; harder OTel/stdlib bridge discipline
alternatives.vendor_agent_only: Datadog auto-instrument without app context — use as export sink, still emit structured app logs

do: Log one structured event per meaningful step with keys, not f-strings only
clear_contextvars at request start; bind request_id/trace_id
Propagate W3C tracecontext on outbound httpx
Separate live vs ready probes; ready fails closed if DB down
Redact secrets/PII processors; never log Authorization headers or bodies with tokens
Sample traces in high-QPS paths; always sample errors
dont: Don't console.log / print random strings on request paths
Don't log full request/response bodies by default
Don't count health checks in error-rate or latency SLIs without filtering
Don't block the event loop in logging processors
Don't put Sentry DSN or OTLP keys in client bundles
Don't use a single /health that does heavy DB work for k8s liveness (causes restart loops)

import logging
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import AsyncIterator, Callable

import structlog
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Response
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.http.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter
from opentelemetry.instrumentation.fastapi import FastAPIInstrumentor
from opentelemetry.sdk.resources import Resource
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor

def configure_logging(level: str = "INFO") -> None:
    structlog.configure(
        processors=[
            structlog.contextvars.merge_contextvars,
            structlog.processors.add_log_level,
            structlog.processors.TimeStamper(fmt="iso", utc=True),
            structlog.processors.StackInfoRenderer(),
            structlog.processors.format_exc_info,
            structlog.processors.JSONRenderer(),
        ],
        wrapper_class=structlog.make_filtering_bound_logger(getattr(logging, level)),
        cache_logger_on_first_use=True,
    )

def configure_tracing(service_name: str, endpoint: str | None) -> None:
    if not endpoint:
        return
    provider = TracerProvider(resource=Resource.create({"service.name": service_name}))
    provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(OTLPSpanExporter(endpoint=endpoint)))
    trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)

log = structlog.get_logger()

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
    app.state.ready = True
    yield
    app.state.ready = False

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)
FastAPIInstrumentor.instrument_app(app)

@app.middleware("http")
async def access_log(request: Request, call_next: Callable) -> Response:
    structlog.contextvars.clear_contextvars()
    rid = request.headers.get("x-request-id") or str(uuid.uuid4())
    structlog.contextvars.bind_contextvars(
        request_id=rid, method=request.method, path=request.url.path
    )
    start = time.perf_counter()
    response = await call_next(request)
    if request.url.path not in {"/health/live", "/health/ready"}:
        log.info(
            "request_completed",
            status=response.status_code,
            duration_ms=round((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000, 2),
        )
    response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = rid
    return response

@app.get("/health/live")
async def live() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok"}

@app.get("/health/ready")
async def ready(request: Request) -> dict[str, str]:
    # real: SELECT 1 / pool checkout
    return {"status": "ok" if getattr(request.app.state, "ready", False) else "starting"}
failure_modes: No request_id → cannot correlate browser → BFF → Python → DB
Health probe hits DB on liveness → cascading restarts under DB blip
Unbounded DEBUG logs or body dumps → cost + secret leak
OTel exporter sync I/O on hot path without batch processor → latency
Missing instrumentations on httpx/SQLAlchemy → partial traces
Sentry noise from expected 4xx without before_send filter
contextvars not cleared → cross-request field bleed under concurrency
anti_patterns: Single /health used for both live and ready with heavy checks
Logging middleware that awaits cloud upload inline
Agent scaffolding loguru + print mix without contextvars

ts_boundary: Align field names with observability.md TS LogEvent (level, message/event, userId→user_id, traceId, durationMs→duration_ms). Propagate X-Request-ID and traceparent from Next Server Actions/Route Handlers into Python. Same OTLP backend for unified traces. Sentry projects can be separate but share release naming.
rust_boundary: Rust uses tracing + OTLP (see observability.md). Same service.name / deployment.environment conventions. Prefer shared collector; do not invent a second log schema for Axum.
supabase_boundary: Log db_error codes not full SQL with secrets. Ready check may use pool checkout or lightweight SELECT 1 on service connection. Never log service_role key. RLS denials are expected 403s — don't page on them without rate.

Health endpoints as unauthenticated info leak (versions, dependency hosts)

Structured keys controlled by app; user content only in values
Minimal ready payload {status}; protect admin debug routes
Fixed OTLP endpoint from env; no user URLs
Attribute size limits; never attach raw bodies to spans
